# Stage 3: Temporal Clustering

We attempt to introduce a temporal aspect to our previous clustering methods by using an "expanding window" approach and tracking the cluster membership tracking.

## 2. K-means clustering w/ time

### 2.1 Setup

First attempt: Cadia only

We'll set our initial parameters for attempting K-means clustering (k = 2):

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
start_window <- 10

n_pts <- nrow(cadia_D)
n_dates <- ncol(cadia_D)

n_iters <- n_dates - start_window + 1
```

```{r}
n_dates
n_iters
```

We will set a matrix to store our cluster memberships:

```{r}
cluster_membership_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

# rename the columns to correspond to dates

iter_dates <- colnames(cadia_D)[start_window:n_dates]

colnames(cluster_membership_mat) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
#head(cluster_membership_mat)
dim(cluster_membership_mat)
```

### 2.2 Temporal Clustering Loop

#### K = 2

```{r}
for (i in start_window:n_dates) {
  x <- cadia_D[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # k-means
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k, nstart = 20)
  
  # displacement at newest date
  
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # median newest displacement for each cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # order clusters from lower to higher median disp
  cluster_order <- order(cluster_medians)
  
  # replace arbitrary K-means labels w/ ordered labels
  ordered_clusters <- match(
    km$cluster,
    cluster_order
  )
  
  # store memberships
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  cluster_membership_mat[, iter] <- ordered_clusters
}
```

```{r}
head(cluster_membership_mat)
```

```{r}
table(cluster_membership_mat[, 1])
table(cluster_membership_mat[, 2])
table(cluster_membership_mat[, ncol(cluster_membership_mat)])
```

The goal of storing the cluster memberships in such a matrix is to be able to compare the clusters and see if we can identify any noticeable patterns between clusters and within clusters. We aim to do so using ArcGIS and compare the cluster memberships with the actual deformation behaviour, as we did before, but adding the time element. A possible output of this is through an animation, showing the cluster memberships over time.

ArcGIS requires the input data to be formatted in a certain way to be able to easily correspond an observation with its geographical position and attribute of interest, at a certain time. The dataset must be recognised as a time-enabled dataset. However, with our current dataset, ArcGIS sees each cluster date as separate attributes of one feature, whereas it's easier to create a time-enabled animation if each cluster membership at each date is a separate observation. These separate observations have a corresponding single Date field that ArcGIS can use.

- Each point must contain its own assigned time value.

```{r}
# Change matrix to calculate summary stats

# create empty matrix
change_mat <- matrix(
  0,
  nrow = nrow(cluster_membership_mat),
  ncol = ncol(cluster_membership_mat)
)

# compute every iter w/ the previous iter
  # store TRUE or FALSE if current col is same as previous col
change_mat[, 2:ncol(change_mat)] <- 
  cluster_membership_mat[, 2:ncol(cluster_membership_mat)] !=
  cluster_membership_mat[, 1:(ncol(cluster_membership_mat) - 1)]

# convert T/F to 1 or 0
change_mat <- change_mat * 1

colnames(change_mat) <- paste0(
  "changed_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
dim(change_mat)
head(change_mat)
```

```{r}
colSums(change_mat)
```

```{r}
# Plotting the changes
cadia_dates <- as.Date(
  sub("D_", "", iter_dates),
  format = "%Y%m%d")

changes_per_date <- colSums(change_mat)

plot(
  cadia_dates,
  changes_per_date,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Date",
  ylab = "Number of points changing cluster",
  main = "Cadia: Temporal cluster membership changes")

```

- The resulting plot contains the number of cluster membership changes per date, including only 35 dates, as we cluster the first 10 dates initially.

- Interesting that the general trend of the plot is a decline over time. This may be due to:

  - Earlier cluster comparisons involves less overall observations, so increasing the number of dates may be more influential.

    - For example, increasing from 10 to 11 dates means the new observation is 1/11 of the information going into the second clustering. This is much more influential than going from 40 dates to 41 dates, where the new observation is only 1/41 of the information.

  - Increasing the number of observations may result in the time-series shapes/clusters becoming better established/stabilised.

    - K-means involves calculating the cluster centroids, and a larger total number of observations may better represent the sub-populations of a dataset.

However, the spatial representation of these changes may be more informative than this summary.

We convert the data from wide to long format for convenience when we use ArcGIS:

```{r}
# convert
cadia_cluster_long <- as.data.frame(cluster_membership_mat)

cadia_cluster_long$PT_ID <- seq_len(nrow(cadia_cluster_long))

cadia_cluster_long <- cadia_cluster_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("cluster_"),
    names_to = "Date",
    values_to = "Cluster"
  )
```

```{r}
head(cadia_cluster_long)
```

```{r}
# convert cluster date text to ACTUAL date
cadia_cluster_long$Date <- sub(
  "^cluster_",
  "",
  cadia_cluster_long$Date
)

cadia_cluster_long$Date <- as.Date(
  cadia_cluster_long$Date,
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
str(cadia_cluster_long)
```

We now create a new dataset containing only essential geographical information and cluster change information.

```{r}
cadia_change_long <- as.data.frame(change_mat)

cadia_change_long$PT_ID <- seq_len(nrow(cadia_change_long))

cadia_change_long <- cadia_change_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("changed_"),
    names_to = "Date",
    values_to = "Changed"
  )

cadia_change_long$Date <- sub(
  "^changed_",
  "",
  cadia_change_long$Date
)

cadia_change_long$Date <- as.Date(
  cadia_change_long$Date,
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
View(cadia_change_long)
```

```{r}
# combine cluster + change info

cadia_cluster_summary <- cadia_cluster_long %>%
  left_join(
    cadia_change_long,
    by = c("PT_ID", "Date")
  )

head(cadia_cluster_summary)
```

```{r}
cadia_data_summary <- data.frame(
  PT_ID = seq_len(nrow(cadia)),
  lon = cadia$lon,
  lat = cadia$lat,
  coherence = cadia$coherence
)
```

```{r}
# combine geographical info w/ cluster info
cadia_cluster_summary <- cadia_cluster_summary %>%
  left_join(
    cadia_data_summary,
    by = "PT_ID"
  )
```

```{r}
View(cadia_cluster_summary)
```

```{r}
# rearrange cols to be similar to original data
cadia_cluster_summary <- cadia_cluster_summary %>%
  select(
    PT_ID,
    coherence,
    lon,
    lat,
    Date,
    Cluster,
    Changed
  )
```

```{r}
write.csv(
  cadia_cluster_summary,
```

### 2.3 Cumulative displacement tracking for comparison

We can try to create a similar animation as the cluster membership tracking animation, but with just the cumulative displacement over time. It may act as a "baseline" that we can use in overall comparisons. This is straightforward, as the data is already given in such form. Although tracking the velocity through animation was another option, it was difficult to determine the best representation and calculation of velocity (expanding window, rolling window, internal velocity).

The process is just converting the data to long form:

```{r}
cadia_disp_long <- as.data.frame(cadia_D_mat)

cadia_disp_long$PT_ID <- seq_len(nrow(cadia_disp_long))
```

## 3. Hierarchical clustering

Same pipeline and processing, except the hierarchical clustering step.

### 3.1 Temporal clustering

#### K = 2

```{r}
k <- 2

cluster_membership_mat_hc <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_hc) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
for (i in start_window:n_dates) {
  x <- cadia_D[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # hierarchical clustering
  x_dist <- dist(x, method = "euclidean")
  
  hc <- hclust(x_dist, method = "ward.D2")
  
  # store resulting clusters
  hc_clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)
  
  # displacement at newest date
  
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # median newest displacement for each cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    hc_clusters,
    median
  )
  
  # order clusters from lower to higher median disp
  cluster_order <- order(cluster_medians)
  
  # replace arbitrary K-means labels w/ ordered labels
  ordered_clusters <- match(
    hc_clusters,
    cluster_order
  )
  
  # store memberships
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  cluster_membership_mat_hc[, iter] <- ordered_clusters
}
```

```{r}
# check matrix
apply(cluster_membership_mat_hc, 2, table)
```

```{r}
change_mat_hc <- matrix(

  cluster_membership_mat_hc[, 1:(ncol(cluster_membership_mat_hc) - 1)]

change_mat_hc <- change_mat_hc * 1

colnames(change_mat_hc) <- paste0(
  "changed_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

#### K = 3

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

k <- 3

cluster_membership_mat_hc_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

# rename the columns to correspond to dates

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_hc_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
for (i in start_window:n_dates) {
  x <- cadia_D[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # hierarchical clustering
  x_dist <- dist(x, method = "euclidean")
  
  hc <- hclust(x_dist, method = "ward.D2")
  
  # store resulting clusters
  hc_clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)
  
  # displacement at newest date
  
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # median newest displacement for each cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    hc_clusters,
    median
  )
  
  # order clusters from lower to higher median disp
  cluster_order <- order(cluster_medians)
  
  # replace arbitrary K-means labels w/ ordered labels
  ordered_clusters <- match(
    hc_clusters,
    cluster_order
  )
  
  # store memberships
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  cluster_membership_mat_hc_k3[, iter] <- ordered_clusters
}
```

## 4. Validation Metrics

To evaluate our results quantitatively, as we already have done so spatially using ArcGIS, we can experiment using different metrics.

- For consistency with the previous stages, we will use average silhouette score, but calculating it for each method and k value for each time acquistion.

- Total number of membership changes from each point plotted against time.

### 4.1 Silhouette Score

Same process as previous stages but calculating the average silhouette score at each time acquisition.

#### K-means: K = 2

```{r}
# reconstruct dist matrix for each window
library(cluster)

cadia_sil_km_k2 <- numeric(n_iters)

for (i in start_window:n_dates) {
  
  # same expanding window used for clustering
  x <- cadia_D[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # corresponding iteration
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  # cluster memberships already calculated
  clusters <- cluster_membership_mat[, iter]
  
  # Euclidean distances for this window
  x_dist <- dist(x, method = "euclidean")
  
  # silhouette
  sil <- silhouette(clusters, x_dist)
  
  # average silhouette
  cadia_sil_km_k2[iter] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}
  main = "Cadia: Temporal Silhouette Score - K-means k = 2"
)
```

# 3.1. Altered Temporal Clustering Workflow

Instead of interpreting the clusters after reordering their respective labels (based on the median of each cluster's latest cumulative displacement observations), we can implement a fixed-threshold idea. This uses a fixed threshold to compare and assign cluster labels (again, after the actual clustering is completed) instead of recalculating the median each time.

We still compute the median cumulative displacement of the latest acquisition, but instead of relabelling clusters by ordering the medians, we compare it to a threshold to determine whether it is "concerning" or "normal" (which are the two different clusters).

## 3.1.1. K-means clustering

### K = 2

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
start_window <- 10
# added threshold for median comparison
threshold <- -10

n_pts <- nrow(cadia_D)
n_dates <- ncol(cadia_D)

n_iters <- n_dates - start_window + 1
```

```{r}
# storing clusters
cluster_membership_mat_v2_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_v2_k2) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
cluster_status_mat_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

# rename the columns to correspond to dates

iter_dates <- colnames(cadia_D)[start_window:n_dates]

colnames(cluster_status_mat_k2) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
# debugging
cluster_medians_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_medians_mat) <- c(
  "Lower median",
  "Higher median"
)
```

```{r}
for (i in start_window:n_dates) {
  x <- cadia_D[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # k-means
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k, nstart = 20)
  
  # displacement at newest date
  
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  # raw membership
  cluster_membership_mat_v2_k2[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # median newest displacement for each cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # order clusters from lower to higher median disp - plotting
  ordered_medians <- sort(cluster_medians)
  
  # store medians
  cluster_medians_mat[iter, ] <- ordered_medians
  
  # replace arbitrary K-means labels w/ ordered labels
  # USING NEW threshold !!
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold,
    1, #  1 = concerning
    0 #   0 = normal-ish
  )
  
  # assign each point resulting status
  pt_status <- cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  cluster_status_mat_k2[, iter] <- pt_status
}
```



```{r}
par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2) + 0.1)

matplot(
  cadia_dates,
  cluster_medians_mat,
  type = "l",
  lty = 1,
  col = c("black", "red"),
  xlab = "Date",
  ylab = "Median cumulative displacement (mm)",
  main = "Cadia: K-means Cluster Median Displacement"
)

abline(
  h = threshold,
  lty = 2,
  col = "black"
)

legend(
  "bottomleft",
  legend = c(
    "More-negative displacement cluster",
    "Less-negative displacement cluster",
    paste0(threshold, " mm threshold")
  ),
  col = c("black", "red", "black"),
  lty = c(1, 1, 2),
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.8
)
```

- The two lines in the above plot represent the median newest-date cumulative displacement of the two groups found by K-means at each expanding window.

- The red line (representing one cluster, after re-labelling based on the threshold rule) stays relatively stable around +1 to +3 mm.

- The black line cluster becomes increasingly negative over time. It begins at roughly -5mm and reaches approximately -10mm by June/July 2017, and finally, reaches approximately -19mm by February 2018 (one month before failure).

- The threshold was chosen based on knowledge of the failure after it occurred.

#### Investigating results

- Examine how many points are "concerning" and if they increase/decrease/stay the same over time.

```{r}
n_concerning_k2 <- colSums(cluster_status_mat_k2)

percent_concerning_k2 <-
  n_concerning_k2 / n_pts * 100
```

```{r}
plot(
  cadia_dates,
  percent_concerning_k2,
  type = "b",
  xlab = "Date",
  ylab = "Points in concerning cluster (%)",
  main = "Cadia: Fixed-threshold K-means (k = 2)"
)
```

- The above plot displays the number of points in the "Concerning" cluster (%).

- Before June/July 2017, neither K-means cluster has median displacement of -10mm or less.

- As we apply the threshold to the cluster median (not every separate point), every point belonging to that cluster becomes "concerning" simultaneously.

- The percentage subsequently remains relatively stable at approximately 44–48%.

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop

for (i in start_window:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered[
    , 1:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # displacement at newest date
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # current iteration number
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  # store raw cluster membership
  cluster_membership_mat_filtered_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # median newest displacement
    # for each raw cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # ordered medians only for plotting
  ordered_medians <- sort(
    cluster_medians
  )
  
  cluster_medians_mat_filtered_k2[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_medians
  
  # classify each cluster using THRESHOLD
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold,
    1,   # concerning
    0    # non-concerning
  )
  
  # each point inherits its cluster's status
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    km$cluster
  ]
  
  cluster_status_mat_filtered_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- pt_status
}
```

### K = 3

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

k <- 3
start_window <- 10
# added threshold for median comparison
threshold <- -10

n_pts <- nrow(cadia_D)
n_dates <- ncol(cadia_D)

n_iters <- n_dates - start_window + 1
```

```{r}
cluster_membership_mat_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
cluster_status_mat_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts,
  ncol = n_iters
)

# rename the columns to correspond to dates

iter_dates <- colnames(cadia_D)[start_window:n_dates]

colnames(cluster_status_mat_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates)
)
```

```{r}
# debugging
cluster_medians_mat_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_medians_mat_k3) <- c(
  "Lower median",
  "Middle median",
  "Highest median"
)
```

```{r}
for (i in start_window:n_dates) {
  
  x <- cadia_D[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]
  
  # k-means
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k, nstart = 20)
  
  # displacement at newest date
  
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  # store raw K-means membership
  cluster_membership_mat_k3[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # median newest displacement for each cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # order clusters from lower to higher median disp
  ordered_medians <- sort(cluster_medians)
  
  # store medians
  cluster_medians_mat_k3[iter, ] <- ordered_medians
  
  # replace arbitrary K-means labels w/ ordered labels
  # USING NEW threshold !!
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold,
    1, #  1 = concerning
    0 #   0 = normal-ish
  )
  
  # assign each point resulting status
  pt_status <- cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  cluster_status_mat_k3[, iter] <- pt_status
}
```

- k = 3

- After K-means finds 3 clusters, the algorithm loops to calculate each cluster's median displacement and assign each cluster a status of 0 (normal) or 1 (concerning).

#### Coherence Filtering

Same data setup as k = 2 version.

```{r}
# temporal clustering setup
set.seed(1234)

k <- 3

threshold_med_concerning <- -10
threshold_high_concerning <- -20
```

```{r}
# cluster membership matrix
cluster_membership_mat_filtered_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_filtered_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# status matrix
cluster_status_mat_filtered_k3_3class <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_filtered_k3_3class) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# medians matrix
cluster_medians_mat_filtered_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = 3
)

colnames(cluster_medians_mat_filtered_k3) <- c(
  "Lower median",
  "Middle median",
  "Higher median"
)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
for (i in start_window:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered[, 1:i, drop = FALSE]

  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # newest cumulative displacement
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  iter <- i - start_window + 1
  
  # store raw cluster memberships: 1, 2, 3
  cluster_membership_mat_filtered_k3[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # median newest displacement for each raw cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # ordered medians for plotting only
  ordered_medians <- sort(cluster_medians)
  
  cluster_medians_mat_filtered_k3[iter, ] <-
    ordered_medians
  
  # classify each cluster into 3 categories
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold_high_concerning,
    2,  # concerning
    ifelse(
      cluster_medians <= threshold_med_concerning,
      1,  # elevated
      0   # lower deformation
    )
  )
  
  # each point takes its cluster's classification
  pt_status <- cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  cluster_status_mat_filtered_k3_3class[, iter] <-
    pt_status
}
```

## 3.1.2 Silhouette Score

We calculate the silhouette score for the filtered data versions.

```{r}
# expanding-window silhouette: k = 2

n_iters_expand_k2 <- ncol(
  cluster_membership_mat_filtered_k2
)

silhouette_expand_k2 <- numeric(
  n_iters_expand_k2
)

for (iter in 1:n_iters_expand_k2) {
  
  # expanding window ends at:
  i <- start_window + iter - 1
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered[
    , 1:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  clusters <-
    cluster_membership_mat_filtered_k2[, iter]
  
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    clusters,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_expand_k2[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

# 4. Sliding Window Temporal Clustering Workflow

## Median Cumulative Displacement Version

```{r}
# filtered cadia dataset including 0 baseline
cadia_D_filtered_sliding <- cadia_D_filtered
```

```{r}
dim(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering setup
# sliding window size 3 instead of expanding by 1

set.seed(1234)

k <- 3
window_size <- 3
threshold_1 <- -3
threshold_2 <- -5

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

# number of overlapping sliding windows
n_iters_filtered <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

# date representing each window = final date in window
iter_dates_filtered <- colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
  window_size:n_dates_filtered
]
```

```{r}
# membership matrix
cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# status matrix
cluster_status_mat_sliding_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_sliding_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# medians matrix
cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k3) <- c(
  "Lower median",
  "Middle median",
  "Higher median"
)
```

```{r}
n_iters_filtered
ncol(cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k2)
length(iter_dates_filtered)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each pt to 0 at the start of each window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # displacement at newest date
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # current iteration number
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # store raw cluster membership
  cluster_membership_mat_sliding_k3[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # median newest displacement
  # for each raw cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # ordered medians only for plotting
  ordered_medians <- sort(
    cluster_medians
  )
  
  cluster_medians_mat_sliding_k3[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_medians
  
  # classify each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold_2,
    2,
    ifelse(
      cluster_medians <= threshold_1,
      1,
      0
    )
  )
  
  # each point inherits the status of its cluster
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]
  
  cluster_status_mat_sliding_k3[
    , iter
  ] <- pt_status
  
}
```

## Median Velocity Version

### K = 2

```{r}
# setup
set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 3
velocity_threshold <- -25

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]
```

```{r}
cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub("^D_", "", colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
head(cadia_all_dates)
diff(cadia_all_dates)
```

```{r}
# membership matrix
cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
cluster_status_mat_velocity_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_velocity_k2) <-
  colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2)
```

```{r}
# median matrix
cluster_velocity_mat_k2 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_velocity_mat_k2) <- c(
  "Lower velocity",
  "Higher velocity"
)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop - velocity version

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # current 3-date displacement window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # dates in current window
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  # time from start of window in days
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # K-means on displacement trajectories
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  # iteration number
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # store raw cluster membership
  cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # velocity for each individual point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # median velocity for each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_velocities <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # ordered values just for plotting/inspection
  ordered_velocities <- sort(
    cluster_velocities
  )
  
  cluster_velocity_mat_k2[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_velocities
  
  # classify each K-means cluster using fixed velocity threshold
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocities <= velocity_threshold,
    1,   # concerning negative velocity
    0    # non-concerning
  )
  
  # every point inherits the status of its K-means cluster
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]
  
  # store point status
  cluster_status_mat_velocity_k2[
    , iter
  ] <- pt_status
}
```

### K = 3

```{r}
set.seed(1234)

k <- 3
window_size <- 3
threshold_1 <- -25
threshold_2 <- -75

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]

cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub("^D_", "", colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
cluster_status_mat_velocity_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(cluster_status_mat_velocity_k3) <-
  colnames(cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3)
```

```{r}
cluster_velocity_mat_k3 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

colnames(cluster_velocity_mat_k3) <- c(
  "Lower velocity",
  "Middle velocity",
  "Higher velocity"
)
```

#### Loop

```{r}
for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # extract current 3-date window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each point to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # dates for current window
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  # time in days from start of window
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # K-means on rebased displacement
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # store RAW K-means membership
  cluster_membership_mat_velocity_k3[
    , iter
  ] <- km$cluster
  
  # velocity of each individual point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) {
      coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
    }
  )
  
  # mm/day -> mm/year
  point_velocity <- point_velocity * 365.25
  
  # median velocity of each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_velocities <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # sort ONLY for inspection
  ordered_velocities <- sort(
    cluster_velocities
  )
  
  cluster_velocity_mat_k3[
    iter,
  ] <- ordered_velocities
  
  # classify raw clusters by median velocity
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocities <= threshold_2,
    2,
    ifelse(
      cluster_velocities <= threshold_1,
      1,
      0
    )
  )
  
  # each point inherits its cluster's status
  pt_status <- cluster_status[
    as.character(km$cluster)
  ]

cluster_status_mat_velocity_k3[
  , iter
] <- pt_status
}
```

# 5. DBSCAN Sliding Window Temporal Clustering

Same concept / approach as K-means, but with DBSCAN. This means we have to tune the hyperparameters instead.

```{r}
# setup
library(dbscan)

window_size <- 3

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_filtered <-
  n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_filtered <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]
```

```{r}
# cluster membership matrix
dbscan_membership_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(dbscan_membership_mat) <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
)
```

```{r}
# noise matrix
dbscan_noise_mat <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

colnames(dbscan_noise_mat) <-
  colnames(dbscan_membership_mat)
```

We will test the process on one temporal window first.

```{r}
# initial test HP: minPts
minPts <- 5
```

We use minPts = 5 as a test. This aligns with the common rule to choose the minPts value in relation to dimensionality, often around double the number of dimensions as a starting point.

```{r}
# initial test HP: eps
x_test <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
  , 1:3,
  drop = FALSE
]

x_test <- sweep(
  x_test,
  1,
  x_test[, 1],
  FUN = "-"
)
```

```{r}
x_test_db <- x_test[, -1, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
kNNdistplot(
  x_test_db,
  k = minPts
)
abline(h = 1, col = "red")
```

The k-NN plot suggests an eps value of approximately 1 to be appropriate (for an initial test).\

```{r}
eps <- 1
```

```{r}
# test w/ 1 window
db_test <- dbscan(
  x_test_db,
  eps = 1,
  minPts = 5
)

table(db_test$cluster)
```

```{r}
mean(db_test$cluster == 0)
```

The initial test seems fairly reasonable, however almost all the points fall into one cluster. There is 7.5% of noise present out of the points in each 3-date displacement windows.

### Displacement Version: Temporal Clustering Loop

```{r}
# full loop
  # minPts = 5
  # eps = 1.2 v2

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # current 3-date sliding window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # reset each pt to 0 at start of window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # remove first col cause its all 0 now
  x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  db <- dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = eps,
    minPts = minPts
  )
  
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # raw DBSCAN cluster
  dbscan_membership_mat[, iter] <-
    db$cluster
  
  # 1 = noise/anomaly candidate
  # 0 = belongs to a DBSCAN cluster
  dbscan_noise_mat[, iter] <-
    as.integer(db$cluster == 0)
}
```

### Testing other hyperparameters (eps, minPts):

```{r}
eps_values <- c(0.8, 1.0, 1.2, 1.5)
minPts_values <- c(5, 10)
```

```{r}
# wrapped loop to test
dbscan_tuning <- data.frame()

for (eps_val in eps_values) {
  
  for (minPts_val in minPts_values) {
    
    noise_mat_temp <- matrix(
      NA,
      nrow = n_pts_filtered,
      ncol = n_iters_filtered
    )
    
    for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
      
      start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
      
      x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
        , start_idx:i,
        drop = FALSE
      ]
      
      # rebase window
      x <- sweep(
        x,
        1,
        x[, 1],
        FUN = "-"
      )
      
      db <- dbscan(
        x,
        eps = eps_val,
        minPts = minPts_val
      )
      
      iter <- i - window_size + 1
      
      # 1 = noise, 0 = clustered
      noise_mat_temp[, iter] <- as.integer(db$cluster == 0)
    }
    
    noise_per_iter_temp <- colSums(noise_mat_temp)
    
    dbscan_tuning <- rbind(
      dbscan_tuning,
      data.frame(
        eps = eps_val,
        minPts = minPts_val,
        Iteration = 1:n_iters_filtered,
        Date = iter_dates_filtered,
        NoisePoints = noise_per_iter_temp
      )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r}
# plot comparison
ggplot(
  dbscan_tuning,
  aes(
    x = Iteration,
    y = NoisePoints,
    group = interaction(eps, minPts),
    linetype = factor(minPts)
  )
) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ eps) +
  labs(
    x = "Sliding window iteration",
    y = "Number of DBSCAN noise points",
    linetype = "minPts"
  )
```

```{r}

  group_by(eps, minPts) %>%
  summarise(
    MeanNoise = mean(NoisePoints),
```

## 6. Sliding Window w/ 5 Acquisitions

Instead of 3.

### Median Cumulative Displacement

#### K = 2

```{r}
# temporal clustering setup
# sliding window size 5 instead of expanding by 1

set.seed(1234)

k <- 2
window_size <- 5
threshold_w5 <- -4 # change after checking

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

# number of overlapping sliding windows
n_iters_filtered <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

# date representing each window = final date in window
iter_dates_filtered <- colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
  window_size:n_dates_filtered
]
```

```{r}
# matrices

cluster_membership_mat_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

status_mat_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_filtered
)

medians_mat_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_filtered,
  ncol = k
)

# silhoutte score for later
silhouette_w5 <- numeric(n_iters_filtered)

colnames(cluster_membership_mat_w5) <-
  paste0(
    "cluster_",
    sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
  )

colnames(status_mat_w5) <-
  paste0(
    "cluster_",
    sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_filtered)
  )

colnames(medians_mat_w5) <- c(
  "Lower_Cluster",
  "Higher_Cluster"
)
```

```{r}
# check
n_iters_filtered
ncol(cluster_membership_mat_w5)
length(iter_dates_filtered)
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
# w = 5 version
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # Extract window
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase first observation to zero
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # K-means
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = 2,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_w5[iter] <- mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
  
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  cluster_membership_mat_w5[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # Displacement at end of window
  latest_disp <- x[, ncol(x)]
  
  # Median for each raw K-means cluster
  cluster_medians <- tapply(
    latest_disp,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  # Sorted ONLY for plotting
  medians_mat_w5[iter, ] <- sort(cluster_medians)
  
  # Apply fixed threshold
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_medians <= threshold_w5,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  # Give every point its cluster's status
  status_mat_w5[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
}
```

```{r}
  type = "l",
  xlab = "Window",
  ylab = "Lower cluster median displacement"
)
```

### Median Velocity version

#### K = 2

```{r}
window_size <- 5
k <- 2

n_pts_filtered <- nrow(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

n_iters_vel_w5 <- n_dates_filtered - window_size + 1

iter_dates_vel_w5 <-
  colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)[
    window_size:n_dates_filtered
  ]

cadia_all_dates <- as.Date(
  sub(
    "^D_",
    "",
    colnames(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)
  ),
  format = "%Y%m%d"
)
```

```{r}
cluster_membership_vel_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_vel_w5
)

status_vel_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_vel_w5
)

vel_medians_w5 <- matrix(
  NA,
  nrow = n_iters_vel_w5,
  ncol = 2
)

silhouette_vel_w5 <- numeric(n_iters_vel_w5)

colnames(vel_medians_w5) <-
  c("Lower_Cluster", "Higher_Cluster")

date_names_vel_w5 <- paste0(
  "cluster_",
  sub("^D_", "", iter_dates_vel_w5)
)

colnames(cluster_membership_vel_w5) <- date_names_vel_w5
colnames(status_vel_w5) <- date_names_vel_w5
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
set.seed(1234)

for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  # W5 displacement trajectory
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase
  x <- sweep(x, 1, x[, 1], FUN = "-")
  
  # K-means on trajectory
  km <- kmeans(
    x,
    centers = k,
    nstart = 20
  )
  
  cluster_membership_vel_w5[, iter] <- km$cluster
  
  # Actual acquisition dates
  window_dates <- cadia_all_dates[start_idx:i]
  
  time_days <- as.numeric(
    window_dates - window_dates[1]
  )
  
  # Regression velocity for each point
  point_velocity <- apply(
    x,
    1,
    function(y) coef(lm(y ~ time_days))[2]
  ) * 365.25
  
  # Median velocity of each raw cluster
  cluster_velocity <- tapply(
    point_velocity,
    km$cluster,
    median
  )
  
  vel_medians_w5[iter, ] <-
    sort(cluster_velocity)
  
  # Fixed velocity status
  cluster_status <- ifelse(
    cluster_velocity <= velocity_threshold,
    1,
    0
  )
  
  status_vel_w5[, iter] <-
    cluster_status[km$cluster]
  
  # Silhouette
  sil <- cluster::silhouette(
    km$cluster,
    dist(x)
  )
  
  silhouette_vel_w5[iter] <-
    mean(sil[, "sil_width"])
}
```

```{r}
n_dates_filtered <- ncol(cadia_D_filtered_sliding)

  ]

  ncol = n_iters_db_w5

  nrow = n_pts_filtered,
  ncol = n_iters_db_w5
```

```{r}
# temporal clustering loop
for (i in window_size:n_dates_filtered) {
  
  start_idx <- i - window_size + 1
  iter <- i - window_size + 1
  
  x <- cadia_D_filtered_sliding[
    , start_idx:i,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  
  # Rebase each point within window
  x <- sweep(
    x,
    1,
    x[, 1],
    FUN = "-"
  )
  
  # Remove constant zero baseline
  x_db <- x[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  
  db <- dbscan(
    x_db,
    eps = eps_w5,
    minPts = minPts
  )
  
  dbscan_membership_w5[, iter] <-
    db$cluster
  
  dbscan_noise_w5[, iter] <-
    as.integer(db$cluster == 0)
}
```
